# What price range will your customers accept?

> Free Van Westendorp price sensitivity meter. Paste survey answers for too cheap, cheap, expensive and too expensive and get the acceptable price range, the optimal price point and the indifference price, with a chart and bootstrap bands. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/van-westendorp-pricing-analyzer/)
